recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-18201 unless future terminology work deliberately changes the broader filter-value model.
issue_request: FHIR-18201 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core ValueSet and asked that ValueSet.compose.include.filter explicitly support CodeSystem-defined filters as well as CodeSystem properties, including updates to filter.property, filter.op, filter.value, and an example.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to git 66ae1e40f1bc02283363c872db14035fc795f8f7. That commit edited the ValueSet spreadsheet and notes and added source/valueset/valueset-example-filter.xml; later source migration preserved the relevant wording in source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-13288 clarified the CodeSystem.filter.code side of the same relationship. Later Applied issues FHIR-38104 and FHIR-44866 changed the filter.value details into the current valueset.html#filter-values narrative, explaining why the current filter.value definition intentionally differs from the original 2018 proposal while remaining compatible with FHIR-18201.
reconciliation: No source change was made. ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini, the current ValueSet filter definitions mention filters defined by the system, filter.property as a property or filter, CodeSystem.filter.operator for filter operations, and a linked filter-values section, and the requested CodeSystem-filter example is still present and listed among ValueSet examples.
